Class ClassifiedFailureId

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.ClassifiedFailureId
public final class ClassifiedFailureId extends Object
Whole-token classified failure ids. A result is classified when its message contains one default token, or a caller-supplied extension, and the session actually started.

Default tokens: DEF-<digits>, G<digits> (not inside a hostname such as Zephyrus-G14-GA401), SHAFT#<digits>, BS-<tokens>, ADB-<tokens>. The published extension, included in the default pattern, is FUNC-<token> and Jnn-BUG-<digits> (for example FUNC-J01-BUG-03 and J01-BUG-03). Pass another whole-token Pattern to accepts(String, Pattern) to add a project token.

Never-started sessions are rejected even when they also name an id: the whole token BS-QUOTA, and the text SessionNotCreated.

The same contract is packaged at META-INF/shaft/classified-failure-ids.md.

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_PATTERN

      public static final String DEFAULT_PATTERN
      Whole-token pattern. G<digits> refuses a following letter, digit, or hyphen so a hostname segment such as G14-GA401 is not a locator id. Repeated id segments use {1,} and {0,}, which match the same text as + and * without a nested quantifier.
